name: Prospector Remtravel
summary: In southern Darkshore, Prospector Remtravel leads an Explorers' League dig among ancient relics. The dwarf's scattered focus and the dangers around camp make his work perilous.

sections.title: A Dwarven Dig in Elven Lands
sections.body: The Explorers' League sent Prospector Remtravel across the sea to establish a dig in southern Darkshore. Night elves guard their ancestral lands, yet the League's drive to uncover Azeroth's origins carries its prospectors into forgotten places. Remtravel unearths fossilized history and ancient stones, while aggressive wildlife and hostile local threats make the camp difficult for one scatterbrained dwarf to manage.

sections.title: The Absent-Minded Scholar
sections.body: Prospector Remtravel loses himself in thought and research notes. When he wanders from camp seeking fossils or lost artifacts, predators and hostile creatures can corner him. Those who find him in the wild often have to protect his fragile discoveries and rescue him from Darkshore's dangers.

aliases: who is the dwarf in darkshore
faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is an archaeologist and surveyor from Ironforge, sent by the Explorers' League. His small excavation camp in southern Darkshore is where he seeks ancient relics and fossils.

faq.q: Why is an Ironforge dwarf digging in Darkshore?
aliases: why is a dwarf in darkshore
what is the explorers league doing in darkshore
faq.answer: The Explorers' League searches the known world for titan artifacts, lost history, and ancient fossils. Darkshore's ruins and ties to the distant past make it a place for dwarven archaeological study.
Remtravel loses track of his surroundings and equipment while absorbed in scholarship. He often wanders into danger without noticing the predators and beasts nearby.

faq.q: Is Prospector Remtravel related to anyone in the League?
faq.answer: Prospector Remtravel is believed to be the adventurous uncle Karna Remtravel mentions. She credits him with inspiring her passion for discovery and the wider world.

angles.text: As a dwarf, Remtravel reflects the Explorers' League's determination to piece together dwarven origins, even in the cold, damp woods of Kalimdor.
As a night elf, you may find the League's noisy digging and disturbed ancient soils testing the patience of local sentinels and druids.
